boundary: Owned orthographic preview Canvas and production TechTreeUI/CareerTechTreeUI. Normal profile cache is temporarily seeded and restored: read-only tabs/description/back plus a denied insufficient-RP request that returns before Save; no successful normal node unlock/toggle/persistence. Owned old normal columns are explicitly cleaned before tab callbacks because its production Refresh uses deferred Destroy. The denied node uses the real rendered Button click and original callback, with owned prior columns parked after pointer hit validation and cleaned after dispatch; this does not accept production deferred-destruction lifecycle. Career draft callbacks are memory-only. Not full MainMenu, storage, hardware or automatic focus/navigation acceptance.
